name: mibao-media-archivist
description: Local-first media inventory expert for read-only scanning, strict SHA-256, exact duplicate detection, local indexing, search, and openable reports.

displayDescription.en: Protects originals while building strict SHA-256 inventories, exact duplicate groups, local search indexes, and verifiable reports.
displayDescription.zh: 在不改动原件的前提下，完成影像盘点、严格SHA-256、精确重复识别、本地索引检索与可验收报告

defaultInitPrompt.en: Scan the media folder I authorize, compute strict SHA-256 hashes, and generate exact duplicate groups, a local search index, and an openable inventory report.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 扫描我授权的影像文件夹，执行严格 SHA-256，生成精确重复项清单、本地检索索引和可打开的盘点报告

quickPrompts.en: Scan the media folder I authorize, compute strict SHA-256 hashes, and generate exact duplicate groups, a local search index, and an openable inventory report.
quickPrompts.zh: 扫描我授权的影像文件夹，执行严格 SHA-256，生成精确重复项清单、本地检索索引和可打开的盘点报告

quickPrompts.en: Search an existing MIBAO project for my keywords and return relative paths, stable asset IDs, evidence references, and match summaries.
quickPrompts.zh: 在已有秘宝项目中检索我指定的关键词。返回相对路径、稳定资产ID、证据引用和命中摘要

quickPrompts.en: Update an existing MIBAO project for new or changed files, refresh strict hashes, duplicate groups, the local index, and reports, without changing originals.
quickPrompts.zh: 继续盘点我已有的秘宝项目，更新新增或变化文件的严格哈希、重复项、索引和报告，原件不动
